info.title: Permguard event evidence v1alpha1
info.description: The event log on the control plane, `permguard.api.events.native.v1alpha1`: shipping signed batches, reading blocks of records, signer histories and the discovery document.

200.description: The batch is stored, or was already held.

400.description: Not a signed batch, or unattributable, unverifiable or carrying an unregistered type.

409.description: Out of order (`OutOfOrder`), or the stream forked or is closed (WireError).

503.description: The store is unavailable; the shipper retries.

parameters.description: The producer id; also a filter on the tenant read.

parameters.description: Authenticated offset from a previous page's `next`.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: The `high_watermark` of an export's first page.

parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Record bound, clamped by the server.

parameters.name: limit_bytes

parameters.name: proof

parameters.name: after_class
parameters.description: Cursor: class of the last stream of the previous page; all three `after_*` or none.
parameters.x-grpc-note: one of the three parts of the gRPC `after` stream cursor, which REST splits into `after_class`, `after_producer` and `after_instance`

parameters.name: after_producer
parameters.description: Cursor: producer of the last stream of the previous page.
parameters.x-grpc-note: one of the three parts of the gRPC `after` stream cursor, which REST splits into `after_class`, `after_producer` and `after_instance`

parameters.name: after_instance
parameters.description: Cursor: instance of the last stream of the previous page.

400.description: A malformed bound or cursor, or a range crossing too many spans.

get.summary: What this plane offers of the event log interface

id.description: The deployment's name for this producer.

Producer.x-grpc-note: Part of the event record, which gRPC carries as JSON bytes (never re-encoded as protobuf, so the digests hold): an element of `records` in permguard.control.v1.IngestBatchRequest, permguard.control.v1.ListRecordsResponse and the `record` of permguard.control.v1.GetRecordResponse.

Stream.description: One cryptographic stream: a producer's history for one tenant ledger.
Stream.x-grpc-note: Part of the event record, which gRPC carries as JSON bytes (never re-encoded as protobuf, so the digests hold): an element of `records` in permguard.control.v1.IngestBatchRequest, permguard.control.v1.ListRecordsResponse and the `record` of permguard.control.v1.GetRecordResponse.

HistoryKey.description: The derived history key, kept beside its hash.

values.description: Their canonical typed encodings, positionally matching `pins`.

digest.description: The digest over that encoding: the index key.

HistoryKey.x-grpc-note: Part of the event record, which gRPC carries as JSON bytes (never re-encoded as protobuf, so the digests hold): an element of `records` in permguard.control.v1.IngestBatchRequest, permguard.control.v1.ListRecordsResponse and the `record` of permguard.control.v1.GetRecordResponse.

Record.description: An event record. Digested and stored verbatim. Open: validation ignores members it does not know, so a newer producer may extend a record.

seq.description: Position in the stream; starts at one.

prev.description: The digest of `seq - 1`, or the genesis.

event_id.description: The caller's identifier, unique within the ledger.

occurrence_digest.description: The digest of the occurrence as the caller sent it.

kind.description: The runtime's word for what happened.

Record.x-grpc-note: Part of the event record, which gRPC carries as JSON bytes (never re-encoded as protobuf, so the digests hold): an element of `records` in permguard.control.v1.IngestBatchRequest, permguard.control.v1.ListRecordsResponse and the `record` of permguard.control.v1.GetRecordResponse.

Envelope.description: What a batch attests to. Not a JSON member of the request: it is the canonical JSON inside `signature.payload` (base64url).

head.description: The digest of the record at `last_seq`.

event_types.description: The registered event types covered, sorted and deduplicated.

record_version.description: The record schema version every covered record carries.

Envelope.x-grpc-note: The signed envelope payload, carried as JSON bytes inside the `envelope` field of permguard.control.v1.IngestBatchRequest and in an element of `proof` of permguard.control.v1.ListRecordsResponse; never a protobuf message.

Protected.description: The protected header of a batch signature: the JSON inside `signature.protected` (base64url).

kid.description: Which key, in the producer's published set.

Protected.x-grpc-note: The protected header of the signature, carried as JSON bytes within `envelope` of permguard.control.v1.IngestBatchRequest and within `proof` of permguard.control.v1.ListRecordsResponse.

Signed.description: A signed batch envelope, JWS flattened.
Signed.x-grpc-note: The signed envelope as one JSON document: the `envelope` bytes of permguard.control.v1.IngestBatchRequest, and an element of `proof` of permguard.control.v1.ListRecordsResponse.

Batch.description: One batch: the signed envelope and the records verbatim, in sequence order.

signature.x-grpc-note: The signed envelope (`Signed`) as its canonical JSON bytes.

records.x-grpc-note: Elements are `bytes` holding each record verbatim.

Batch.x-grpc-note: On gRPC the signed envelope and each record are `bytes` holding their JSON text (decoded by Batch::from_wire_parts); on REST they are JSON values of one body.

Acknowledgement.description: The 200 answer of a batch (built inline in the handler).

stored.description: How many records this call added.

Acknowledgement.x-grpc-note: The REST 200 answer. gRPC answers a run-ahead with the same message and an OK status (acked = expected_seq - 1, stored 0, expected_seq set); REST answers it with a 409 (OutOfOrder).

OutOfOrder.description: The 409 answer of a producer that ran ahead: the shared refusal envelope plus where to resume.

class.x-grpc-note: REST-only: gRPC carries the error class in status metadata, and a run-ahead is not an error on gRPC.

code.x-grpc-note: REST-only: gRPC carries the code in status metadata, and a run-ahead is not an error on gRPC.

message.x-grpc-note: REST-only: gRPC carries the message in the status.

OutOfOrder.x-grpc-note: The REST 409 body. gRPC answers a run-ahead with an OK status and IngestBatchResponse{acked: expected_seq - 1, stored: 0, expected_seq}; `acked` and `stored` have no member in the 409. `class`, `code` and `message` are the shared refusal envelope, which gRPC carries as status and metadata instead.

EventBlock.description: One page of event records: the common stream block with typed records.
EventBlock.x-grpc-note: `records`, `proof` and `inclusion` are JSON values here and elements of `repeated bytes` (each the JSON text) on gRPC.

StreamSignersView.description: One producer stream's signer history with the receiver's durable frontier.

acked.description: Everything through this sequence is durable here.

StreamCursor.description: A position in the `(class, producer, instance)` order of one ledger's streams.

SignersDocument.description: The signers answer: one page of streams.

truncated.description: More streams matched than one page carries.

Limits.description: The ceilings a read is clamped to.

max_examined.description: The most positions one page examines while looking for matches.

Limits.x-grpc-note: REST-only: the configuration document's `limits` member has no field in permguard.control.v1.GetEventConfigurationResponse.

Endpoints.description: Absolute URLs where batches are delivered and records are read.

Offsets.description: How a reader's position is spelled.

api.description: The API family an offset belongs to.

editable.description: Whether an edited offset is accepted; never.

event_types.description: The registered event contracts this plane stores.

producer_classes.x-grpc-note: REST-only: not a field of GetEventConfigurationResponse.

filters.description: The filter names a read accepts.
filters.x-grpc-note: REST-only: not a field of GetEventConfigurationResponse.

limits.x-grpc-note: REST-only: not a field of GetEventConfigurationResponse.

Document.x-grpc-note: gRPC GetEventConfigurationResponse omits `producer_classes`, `filters` and `limits`, although the proto comment calls it field for field the JSON document; the handler fills only the six mapped fields.

x-grpc-unmapped.note: `record` holds the JSON bytes of the one record REST answers as the body
the same three members as `stream-common.json` `Coverage`, which two messages share
`from_seq`, `kid` and `jwk` (JSON bytes) of `stream-common.json` `SignerSpan`, whose REST name for the first is `from`
